blurb: Deerpath Golf Course offers 9 or 18 hole rounds with dynamic pricing based on demand and availability. They provide junior golf classes and camps for ages 4-16 through DiscoverGolf programs. The course includes a free-to-use greenspace called The Lawn for putting and chipping practice.
extraNote: Dynamic pricing adjusts rates in real time based on demand, availability, weather, and market conditions · Tee times can be booked online or by phone up to 14 days in advance · No outside food or beverages allowed on property
